case.title: Sattvik Foods v. Annapurna Snacks (SYNTHETIC)
case.description: SYNTHETIC evaluation case: a dispute about prior use of a mark.

passages.text: SYNTHETIC. The plaintiff, Sattvik Foods, registered the mark SATTVIK for snack foods in 2015 and has used it continuously since then.
SYNTHETIC. The defendant states that it adopted its mark honestly in 2023 and that the plaintiff first used SATTVIK only in 2017.
SYNTHETIC. The defendant's invoices show sales under the disputed mark from March 2024 onwards.

judgments.title: Asha Rao v. Bharat Traders (SYNTHETIC)
judgments.text: SYNTHETIC. Prior continuous use of a mark is weighed against the date on which the defendant adopted its mark.
